test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’. The small size of his store __makes it impossible__ for him to stock all the items.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **"The small size of his store makes it impossible for him to stock all the items." is **grammatically correct as it stands.
 
• The subject** "The small size of his store" correctly leads to the effect "makes it impossible for him to stock all the items."**
 
• The verb** "makes" **correctly indicates the cause-effect relationship in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**The small size of his store makes it impossible for him to stock all the items.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "made them impossible"** – This option is incorrect because "them" does not have a clear antecedent in the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "making it impossible"** – This option is incorrect because it changes the structure and meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "is made it impossible"** – This option is grammatically incorrect as it uses both "is" and "made" incorrectly together.
